name: notion
description: Notion tools: search, read a page, list a database's rows, create a page and add text to one.

config.label: Integration token
config.hint: The internal integration secret, from notion.so/profile/integrations. Write it as ${ENV_VAR} to keep it out of the settings file. The integration only sees the pages shared with it.

config.label: Allow writing
config.hint: No means read only: creating pages and adding text are refused. Even with yes, it can only write where the integration was given access.
